_README: Copy this file to 'user_options.json' in the same folder to add your own
dropdown values. That filename is gitignored, so your additions survive a
'git pull' and are never published. Restart ComfyUI after editing it.
'pools' maps a field name to {kind: [values]}. Use '_default' for the
fall-through pool every kind reads when it has no override of its own --
but note that some fields (markings, form, situation, material, and the
other kind-scoped ones) are overridden by EVERY kind, so nothing ever
reads their '_default'. Add to those under a kind name instead. The
ComfyUI console says so if you get it the wrong way round.
Field names: environment, situation, relation, kind, subkind, scale,
condition, form, material, primary_color, accent_color, emitter_color,
markings, surface_detail, appendages, appendage_count, emitters,
emitter_count, armament, armament_count, sensors, sensor_count,
aperture, extras.
Sci-fi kind names: starship, celestial body, space station, alien creature,
spacefarer, robot or mech, alien artifact, surface vehicle, wreck.
Fantasy values go in their own 'fantasy' section with the same shape.
Fantasy kind names: dragon, mythic beast, giant-kin, small folk, hybrid folk,
folk, spirit or elemental, undead, construct, structure, vessel, artifact.
List every built-in value of a field with:
python scripts/builtin_options.py markings --kind starship
python scripts/builtin_options.py subkind --kind dragon --pack fantasy
'tags' is optional and only affects the Scene filter widget. It applies to
subkind, armament, aperture, situation and relation. A value you do not tag
is 'neutral' and is drawn under Any, Peaceful and Conflict alike.
Tags: neutral, peaceful_only, conflict_only.
Three house rules your values should follow, because the engine assumes
them. None is enforced -- your file is yours -- but the console warns:
1. No article. Write 'ion thruster', not 'an ion thruster': the engine
composes articles, counts and plurals ('six ion thrusters').
2. Singular for anything with a count partner (appendages, emitters,
armament, sensors). The engine pluralizes.
3. Describe the SUBJECT, never the rendering and never an absence. A hull
colour is fine; 'cinematic lighting', 'golden hour' or 'shot on 35mm'
will fight whatever style node you pair this with. And say what IS
there -- 'a smooth sensory dome where a face would be', never
'no eyes', which draws eyes.
Constraint rules match values by exact string, so a value you add is not
named by any rule and no rule excludes it. Delete this '_README' key or
leave it; it is ignored either way.

starship: running dark past a picket line
alien creature: shedding a drift of luminous spores
